ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance
be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2-L in the area bounded by

The alley next north of and parallel to West Harrison Street; a line
393.72 feet east of and parallel to North Lavergne Avenue; West
Harrison Street; and a line 356.25 feet east of and parallel to Norh
Lavergne Avenue,

to those of a RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common address of property: 4910 West Harrison Street
